label: preparing
what: Likely preparations for a jubilee celebration, with bread baked and transported to the great-hall area and lantern lighting installed. Innkeeper and freight demonstrably coordinated bread production and delivery; baker knowingly supported jubilee baking and supplied freight, while builder installed lighting. No shown message tells the mayor about the jubilee itself, but secrecy is not established: the mayor explicitly knew of an 18:00 completed-lighting inspection. Secretary and neighbour arranged ordinary appointments/tea; knowing assistance in concealing a celebration is not established.
